home_intro: Founded in 2014, Creative HR Service connects talented professionals with companies through practical recruitment support, career guidance, and professional resume writing across Vapi and nearby industrial areas.
about: Creative HR Service is a trusted recruitment and resume writing partner founded in 2014. Led by Director and Founder J. Ranjan Senapati, the company is built on quality, integrity, customer satisfaction, and personalized placement support for employers and job seekers.
recruitment: Our recruitment service helps companies identify, shortlist, and coordinate suitable candidates across entry-level, skilled, technical, non-technical, and senior roles. We support pharma, chemical, plastics, packaging, textile, garment, office, factory, sales, admin, accounts, HR, operator, engineer, supervisor, and management hiring.
resume: Our resume writing service helps freshers and experienced candidates present their strengths clearly. We create new resumes, improve existing CVs, format profiles professionally, support cover letters, and guide LinkedIn profile improvements.
